script_parts.opening: Namaste ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — Gold Silver Leafing Art ke liye call kar raha hoon. Bhai, seedha baat karta hoon — aapka BL velocity pichle mahine mein 53% girr gaya hai, matlab jo buyers aapko contact kar rahe the, unki sankhya aadhi se bhi kam ho gayi hai. Yeh trend dekh ke humne aapko personally call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, ek cheez samajhna chahta hoon — jab koi buyer aapko call ya message karta hai, toh aap generally kitni jaldi respond kar paate hain, aur kya koi specific problem hai jaise time nahi milta ya leads relevant nahi lagte?
script_parts.value_demo: Dekhiye ji, aapka abhi reply rate sirf 2% hai — matlab 100 mein se 98 buyers ka koi jawab nahi mil raha — aur PNS success rate bhi 23% hai, yani 77% baar buyer aaptak phone pe bhi nahi pahunch pa raha. Iske saath aapka CQS score 68 hai jo 75 ke benchmark se neeche hai, iska direct matlab hai ki aapki listing buyers ko search results mein kam dikhti hai.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai, abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog kholta hoon aur aapke top 2-3 products ki listing mein jo basic cheezein missing hain, jaise price, minimum order quantity, aur product image quality — woh identify karte hain aur main aapko step-by-step guide karta hoon ki 10 minute mein kaise update karein.
script_parts.close: Bhai, aaj ek hi commitment chahiye — sirf yeh 2-3 products update kar lein aur agli baar jab buyer message kare, ek baar reply zaroor karein, chahe short ho. Main 3 din baad ek follow-up call karoonga aur dekhenge ki BL velocity mein kuch movement aaya ya nahi — theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello ji, I'm calling from IndiaMART for Gold Silver Leafing Art. I'll be direct — your BL velocity has dropped by 53% in the last month, meaning the number of buyers reaching out to you has more than halved. We saw this trend and wanted to call you personally.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Bhai, I want to understand one thing — when a buyer calls or messages you, how quickly are you generally able to respond, and is there a specific issue like not having enough time or the leads not feeling relevant to your business?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Right now your reply rate is just 2% — meaning 98 out of 100 buyers are getting no response — and your PNS success rate is only 23%, so 77% of the time buyers can't even reach you on the phone. On top of that, your CQS score is 68, which is below the 75 benchmark, and that directly means your listings are appearing lower in buyer search results.
script_parts_en.action: So bhai, let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and we'll identify the basic gaps in your top 2-3 product listings, things like missing price, minimum order quantity, and image quality — and I'll guide you step-by-step to get those updated in about 10 minutes.
script_parts_en.close: Bhai, I just need one commitment today — update these 2-3 products and the next time a buyer messages you, send at least one reply, even a short one. I'll call you again in 3 days and we'll check together whether the BL velocity has started to recover — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
